metadata.description: Analysis-ready IPBES geography to World Bank economy crosswalk with latest WDI indicator values.
metadata.indicator_value_semantics: Each record's world_bank_indicators object is keyed by WDI indicator code and contains the latest non-null value plus its observation year. Definitions are stored once in the top-level indicator_catalog.
rules: Kosovo is mapped to the World Bank-specific code XKX.
No sovereign/parent economy is inferred for territories or disputed areas.
Missing World Bank coverage is retained explicitly.
